# Third-party 3D assets (Greybox 3D view)

All assets below were downloaded from their official pages on 2026-11-22 and are
**CC0 1.0 (public domain)**. No paid, CC-BY-NC, or ripped assets are included.
Only the files actually used by this proto were copied into this folder.

## Quaternius — Ultimate Animated Character Pack (November 2019)

- Author: Quaternius
- Official pack page: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatedanimatedcharacter.html
- Official OGA mirror (explicit CC0): https://opengameart.org/content/animated-characters-pack
- License page / deed: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- License: **CC0 1.0**. Pack page: “free to use in personal and commercial projects.”
  OGA listing: “License(s): CC0”. (Later Quaternius packs may use QAL; this 2019 pack is CC0 and is not covered retroactively by QAL.)
- Files used: `Cowboy_Male.fbx` (idle, walk, shoot, hit, punch clips).
- Recolor: hero (purple hat/shirt, red scarf, blue jeans) and grunt (brown hat, tan shirt, red scarf, blue jeans) at runtime. No third-party textures were modified on disk.

## Kenney — Nature Kit (2.1)

- Author: Kenney (www.kenney.nl)
- Official page: https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit
- License on page: Creative Commons CC0 — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Included `License.txt` states CC0, free for personal, educational and commercial projects.
- Files used (FBX only; these models are vertex-colored): cactus_short/tall, grass, grass_large, grass_leafs, rock_smallA/B/C, rock_tallA/B, rock_largeA, cliff_block_rock, cliff_large_rock, cliff_top_rock.

Credit is not required under CC0; names and URLs are recorded here for provenance.
